sentence: This project tests a system made from plant materials that protects drugs and other active substances and releases them in a controlled way.
This project designs quantum computer software and hardware together so that quantum computers can solve optimization problems reliably and securely.
This project studies how interactive proofs work when quantum computers are involved and how they connect to optimization problems in physics and chemistry.
This project studies how microbes live in marine invertebrates, why different hosts have different microbes, and how these links change over evolutionary time.
This project develops quantum algorithms that solve large optimization problems and looks for ways to make them use fewer quantum resources.
This project builds a shared computing cluster that supports researchers working in biophysics, chemistry, cybersecurity and mathematics.
This project builds a testbed that combines computing nodes with a quantum processor so researchers can run programs that use both.
This project studies how small extra chromosomes move between strains of the fungus that causes blast disease.
This project studies how different water flow patterns, including ones that mimic spring floods, affect fish, plants, soil and carbon storage in a river and its floodplain.
This project studies how to combine predictions from different calculation methods into one result with a reliable uncertainty for how often protons fuse in the sun.
This project links data on mammals, parasites and pathogens from a prairie research site to online ecological, biodiversity and genomic databases.
This project builds a center where scientists combine data and computer methods to learn how features of cells arise from molecules.
This project develops a one-step test that uses CRISPR to detect a virus in dried blood spots from newborn babies.
This project studies how quarks and gluons move and spin inside protons and other hadrons by analyzing high-energy collisions.
This project studies how white feathers in birds get their color from microscopic structures and how often this trait has evolved.
